subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be resolved by documenting the existing pi-tui newline shortcuts, or should OpenClaw add a supported configurable TUI send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main already supports newline insertion through the editor dependency, but the requested configurable send behavior would add a public TUI config/CLI contract under a repo policy with a high bar for new config surfaces.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior
options.body: Update TUI docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and fallback behavior while keeping Enter-to-send unchanged.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define and test a public TUI send/newline keybinding option across CLI/config/docs if maintainers want this to match the WebChat preference direction.

options.title: Fold Into Composer Roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue open as part of broader TUI composer decisions alongside external-editor and vi-mode requests.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior
recommendation.body: Update TUI docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and fallback behavior while keeping Enter-to-send unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across TUI docs/help and current TUI editor/lifecycle surfaces.
